none: PAS FindID 969603: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17; small module, possibly on clipped flan. Obverse description: Head laureate right. Obverse inscription: [--]NVS AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 14.2mm, Weight: 1.19gms, die axis: 6
